Sharon Zhang

Bio

Sharon attends Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health as a part-time MPH student concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics, while also working as a Senior Product Manager at CVS Health, optimizing use of external claims data across lines of business (Aetna, Retail, Specialty, Caremark, Healthspire).

Previously, she worked as a Senior Solutions Manager at Flatiron Health, where she led knowledge management, customer success, and feature rollouts for the Real-World Evidence (RWE) business in support of cancer researchers, and as a Consultant at Simon-Kucher, where she delivered go-to-market pricing and market access strategies to support drug launches across 10+ countries. She also holds a Bachelor’s degree in Economics from the University of Chicago.

Sharon is passionate about leveraging data to drive impactful decisions and improve public health outcomes.

Interests

  • Observational Research

  • Oncology

  • Mental Health

  • Board Games

  • Hiking

Projects

  • CHAI: Cleaned and analyzed patient chart-abstracted data to support program evaluation of Nigeria Cancer Access Partnership (NCAP)’s impact on patient access to affordable drugs, adherence, and outcomes.

  • Crisis counseling: Conducted exploratory analysis to evaluate the real-world performance and impact of deploying an LLM-based copilot at scale in a WhatsApp-based crisis counseling service in India.

  • ICER evaluation: Supported study design and analysis for a replication of an Institute of Clinical and Economic Review (ICER) cost-effectiveness analysis of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) therapies using electronic health record (EHR) data from Flatiron Health.
